title: Research Data for Specification-Driven Rotor Inverse Design and Numerical Verification
description: Numerical results supporting the manuscript on specification-driven rotor inverse design and numerical verification. The archive contains full-precision requirements, surrogate cross-validation summary, ROSS 2.3.0 candidate verification and diversity results, the six-scenario perturbation study, representative design and modal analysis data, and the bearing-stiffness sweep. Training data and model checkpoints are excluded.
